post.summary: Exchange a JWT assertion for an access token
post.description: OAuth 2.0 JWT-Bearer assertion grant. Submit `grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer` plus a signed JWT `assertion`. Returns a short-lived bearer access token used for subsequent partner API calls.

get.description: Returns metadata about the bearer token currently presented in the Authorization header. Useful for verifying that a token corresponds to the expected partner application.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of SPV requests scoped to the caller's `client_id`.

post.description: Submits an SPV creation request. Validation runs against the spaas-contract template indicated by `templateId`. On success, Zest fires `spv_request.created`. Admin review materialises the SPV; success fires `spv_request.completed`.

403.description: Service not provisioned for partner API

get.description: Returns a single SPV request scoped to the caller's `client_id`.

delete.description: Cancels a pending-review SPV request. Returns 409 if the request is in a terminal state (approved, rejected, or already cancelled).

409.description: SPV request is in a terminal state

post.description: Creates one or more investor records. Always returns 200 with a per-row { status, zestPersonId | error } result keyed by `partnerInvestorId`. Idempotent across replays: a repeated `partnerInvestorId` returns the existing Zest person id. `Idempotency-Key` is optional and provides response-level caching.

403.description: Service not provisioned for partner API

post.description: Creates one or more subscription rows for a single SPV. Per investor: lump sum + share class. `Idempotency-Key` is optional.

403.description: Service not provisioned for partner API

post.description: Uploads a signed subscription form for a partner-managed subscription. Multipart/form-data with a single `file` field. Max 10 MB. Allowed content types: PDF, JPEG, PNG, WEBP. Emits `signed_subscription_form.uploaded` webhook on success.

403.description: Service not provisioned for partner API

409.description: Bid is in a terminal status

post.description: Uploads a wire-transfer receipt + funding metadata (amount / currency / wire_reference) for a partner-managed subscription. Q6c strict order: the signed subscription form must already be on record, otherwise this endpoint returns 409. Emits `funding_receipt.uploaded` webhook on success.

403.description: Service not provisioned for partner API

409.description: Form not on record yet, or terminal status

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: OAuth 2.0 JWT-Bearer assertion grant. Exchange a partner-signed JWT for a short-lived bearer access token, then send that token in the Authorization header on every partner API call.

tags.name: SPV Requests
tags.description: Submit SPV creation requests, inspect their lifecycle, and cancel pending ones. SPV requests are reviewed by Zest admins and produce SPV materialisation on approval.

tags.name: Investors
tags.description: Bulk-create investor records with partial-success semantics. Each row carries its own status / error envelope so a single bad row never fails the batch.

tags.name: Subscriptions
tags.description: Create one or more subscriptions for a single SPV.

tags.name: Subscription Forms
tags.description: Upload signed subscription forms (PDF or image) for partner-managed subscriptions. Files are streamed to private storage and referenced on the Bid.

tags.name: Subscription Fundings
tags.description: Upload wire-transfer receipts plus funding metadata. Strict order: a signed form must already be on record before fundings can be uploaded.

tags.name: Contracts
tags.description: Read-only access to the spaas-contract registry (templates, catalogs, primitives, samples) used to validate SPV-request `attributes`.
